name: refactor-safe
description: Step-by-step refactoring strategy ensuring zero breakage
content: When refactoring, always start by adding tests if they don't exist. Make small, incremental changes. Verify behavior after each change. Do not change public APIs unless necessary and documented.

name: find-errors-secure
description: Security-focused error handling and logging pattern
content: Log errors with context but sanitize sensitive data (PII, secrets). Use structured logging. Ensure error messages returned to the user do not leak internal implementation details.

name: setup-supabase-cli
description: Boilerplate for initializing Supabase in a TypeScript project
content: Initialize Supabase client using environment variables. Create a singleton instance. Add types for your database schema. Ensure RLS policies are enabled on all tables.
